dict.string: Cladiron reads your steps, workouts, heart rate, and — for recovery-aware coaching — your heart-rate variability, resting heart rate, sleep, and body weight, so your activity, Watch-recorded sessions, and readiness appear here. Your health data never leaves your device.
Cladiron saves summaries of your workouts (strength, cardio, intervals, and swim) to Apple Health so they appear system-wide and close your Activity rings.
Cladiron connects to a Bluetooth chest strap to record accurate heart rate during workouts.
Cladiron uses your location to map and measure outdoor runs and rides recorded on your iPhone.
Cladiron uses motion data to better recognize the kind of workout you are doing.
